correctness.rationale: Rotational orthogonality gives T_m e_n=w_n e_(n+m) with w_n=M(n+m/2)/sqrt(M(n)M(n+m)). The diagonal Q_m eigenvalues are q_n=w_n^2-w_(n-m)^2, with negative index weight zero. Triangular integration of g=log M yields B(x)=-log w(x)^2 as average of g'' and B prime as average of g'''; strict signs guarantee all q_n>0. Given g''~c x^-gamma and g'''~-gamma c x^-gamma-1, fixed-width integration gives q_n~gamma c m^3/4 n^(-gamma-1). Telescoping yields trace m. Tail-count inversion handles nonmonotone q_n and gives ordered singular-value asymptotic, precise Schatten and critical-log endpoints. Gamma/polygamma moments give disk gamma=2,c=alpha+1 and Fock gamma=1,c=1/a. Independently used high precision moment ratios at n=5000 for alpha=0,2, a=1,2 and m=1,2,4 to approach the predicted coefficients; these numerical checks corroborate but do not imply infinity.
residual_risks: Finite computations corroborate but do not replace the unrestricted proof.
